title: Databases
description: Connect your work. Shape your own systems.
baseHelp: Create a database, add typed fields, then connect records across your workspace.
noRecords: No matching records. Create a record or adjust this view's filters.
relationHelp: A reverse field is created in the other database. Saving links updates both sides. A one-record limit rejects conflicting links.
kanbanHelp: Add a select or checkbox field to group your Kanban view.
optionsHint: Separate options with commas, for example: Todo, In progress, Done.
typeChangeHelp: Type changes preserve compatible values. Use canonical numbers (42 or 1.5), true/false, or dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. Conflicting records, filters or Kanban groups must be edited first; nothing is cleared.
relationTypeHelp: Relation types stay fixed to preserve both fields and their links. Create a separate field for another type.
noRelationTargets: Create records in the linked database to connect them here.
saveBeforeLinking: Save this page before connecting related records.
emptyContent: Your page is ready for your thoughts.
contentPlaceholder: Write notes, plans and details for this record…
confirmDeleteBase: Delete this database, its records, views and related fields?
confirmDeleteField: Delete this field and its values? Relation fields also remove their reverse field and all links.
confirmDeleteRecord: Delete this page and remove all its relation links?
confirmDeleteView: Delete this saved view? Records will remain.

docs.title: Title
docs.help: Write with blocks, nest documents and link to notes or database records. Backlinks and your knowledge map update when you save.
docs.reloadConfirm: Discard your edits and load the latest saved version?
docs.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? Child documents are kept at the top level.
docs.discardConfirm: Discard your unsaved changes and leave this page?

connections.title: Connections
connections.empty: Link this page from another page, or connect it in the knowledge map.

map.unresolved: {{count}} unresolved links. Use the page picker to resolve ambiguous or missing titles.
map.help: Select a page to see backlinks and related ideas. Double-click a node to open it.
map.label: Relationship label

relationsChanged: These links changed elsewhere. Reload links before saving your selection.
filterHelp: Combine conditions and groups using all or any. Date windows update each day; tags match whole options.

calendarView.setupHelp: Choose the date property for this view. An optional end date creates a range; both dates are included.
calendarView.noDateFields: Add a Date property to this database, then choose it in the calendar view settings.
calendarView.moveHelp: Drag a record to another day, or use its date button. Multi-day records keep their duration.
calendarView.noScheduled: No scheduled records in this period.
calendarView.unscheduledHelp: These records have missing or invalid dates. Open a record to set its dates or fix its range.

workspaceReadOnly: You can view this workspace. An owner can grant editing access.
workspaceSettingsHelp: Choose the sections available in this workspace. Excluding a module keeps its data.
sourceUnavailable: This data source is unavailable to your account.
noSearchResults: No titles match your search in this view.

library.title: Knowledge Library
library.help: Organize workspace pages, database records and imported text into collections. Find relevant source passages with citations.
library.workspaceHelp: Choose a workspace to organize and search its knowledge sources.
library.collectionUnavailable: This collection is no longer available. Choose another collection.
library.linkExisting: Link an existing page or record
library.liveHelp: Linked sources stay current with their workspace page or record. Each search reads the latest saved page or record content.
library.catalogTruncated: The source picker is showing a limited catalog. Additional workspace sources may not appear here.
library.contentPlaceholder: Paste plain text or Markdown to include in this collection…
library.fileError: Choose a nonempty .txt or .md text file with at most {{limit}} characters and no binary content.
library.searchPlaceholder: Search for a topic, phrase or keyword…
library.noMatches: No source passages match these terms. Try another phrase or collection.
library.noSources: Create a collection and add workspace pages, records or imported text to begin.
library.confirmSourceRemoval: Remove this source from the collection? The original workspace page or record is kept.
library.confirmCollectionRemoval: Delete this collection and its source links or imported copies? Original workspace pages and records are kept.
library.refreshWarning: Saved successfully. The library list could not refresh. Retry refreshing before importing again.
library.viewer: You can browse and search this library. Editing requires workspace editor access.

emptyBoardHint: Create a project and add columns to organize your work.
